item.description:
🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica
Visão geral:
• 2 com severidade Crítica
• 8 com severidade Alta
• 12 novas CVEs
• 5 novos advisories/exploits

────────────────────────────────────
Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-116102 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.3
Resumo:
A vulnerability was determined in QuantGeekDev docker-mcp 0.1.0/0.2.0. The impacted element is the function _build_windows_command of the file docker_executor.py. This manipulation of the argument project_name causes os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-116102
 
📰 From Open Source to Enterprise: Understanding the VMware Salt API Evolution
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: 9.1
Resumo:
In this blog, we explore a powerful new capability introduced in VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9.1.1 which further enhances compliance and configuration management. Previously, VCF Operations offered Security Posture Management and Configuration Management only from the user interface. Now, admins have an option to manage compliance and configuration management with programmatic access via the API.
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2026/10/26/from-open-source-to-enterprise-understanding-the-vmware-salt-api-evolution/

🚨 CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Two PHP2Shell Flaws Enabling Remote Code Execution
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.2
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday confirmed active exploitation of the recently patched PHP2Shell flaws by adding them to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. The PHP vulnerabilities, both rated 9.2 on the CVSS scoring system, facilitate unauthenticated remote code execution on affected deployments - CVE-2026-109618 - An out-of-memory
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/cisa-confirms-active-exploitation-of.html
 
🚨 PHP Issues Second Windows Security Update in Five Days to Fix Brotli Code Execution Flaw
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 8.2
Resumo:
PHP has rebuilt its official Windows packages for PHP 8.2 through 8.5 to fix CVE-2026-111497, a flaw in the Brotli compression library that the packages include. The flaw can let an attacker corrupt memory and potentially run code. PHP says the flaw can be reached through the cURL extension when the extension decompresses HTTP responses automatically.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/php-issues-second-windows-security.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-101259 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.3
Resumo:
Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information vulnerability in Apache Camel CoAP component. This issue affects Apache Camel: from 4.0.0 before 4.18.5, from 4.19.0 before 4.22.2. When the CoAP consumer could not build its response once the route had completed, CamelCoapResource caught the resulting exception and sent its message back to the CoAP client as the payload of a 5.00 Internal Server Error resp...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-101259
 
🚨 Microsoft Authenticator Flaw Let Permissionless Android Apps Steal Work Account Tokens
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 6.2
Resumo:
Microsoft has fixed a flaw in its Authenticator app for Android that let a malicious app with no permissions pose as a trusted Microsoft app, such as Teams, and collect sign-in tokens for a victim's work account. Microsoft tracks the flaw as CVE-2026-80097 and fixed it in Authenticator for Android version 6.2606.4246, so anyone using the app should update.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/microsoft-authenticator-flaw-let.html
 
💣 Apple backports CoreGraphics zero-day patches to older iPhones
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
​Apple has backported security patches released last month to older iPhones and iPads, addressing a zero-day bug exploited in "extremely sophisticated" targeted attacks on iOS devices.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/apple/apple-backports-coregraphics-zero-day-patches-to-older-iphones/
 
💣 CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-confirms-php2shell-vulnerabilities-now-exploited-in-attacks/
 
💣 Tailscale warns of SSH flaws allowing root privilege escalation
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Tailscale security team is working to patch almost a dozen security vulnerabilities that could be exploited to steal credentials, crash servers, gain root privileges, and more.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/tailscale-warns-of-serious-ssh-flaws-allowing-root-privilege-escalation/

Sistemas / Cloud - 1Password / Azure / Office / Ubuntu / Windows Server / WordPress

🚨 CVE-2026-99091 - Ubuntu
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: MGMT: Fix status of pending commands flushed on power off cmd_complete_rsp() receives a struct cmd_lookup and, for a pending command that has no cmd_complete callback, falls through to cmd_status_rsp(cmd, data). cmd_status_rsp() reads data as a u8 *, so the status sent comes from the first byte of match->sk's representation, not from match...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-99091
 
🚨 CVE-2026-116107 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.4
Resumo:
A vulnerability was detected in Datafeedr Product Sets Plugin up to 1.3.24 on WordPress. Affected by this issue is the function dfrps_ajax_delete_saved_search of the file functions/ajax.php of the component AJAX Handlers. The manipulation results in missing authorization. Upgrading to version 1.3.25 can resolve this issue. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-116107
 
🚨 CVE-2025-13833 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A vulnerability exists in SecureConnector for Windows when the “Additional Appliance Connections” setting is enabled and the agent’s configuration file contains more than three trusted‑server entries. Some entries omit TLS certificate fingerprints, which allows the agent to accept and establish sessions with a malicious server. An attacker who controls the wired or wireless network can redirect traffic to a malicious...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-13833
 
🚨 USN-8955-1: nginx vulnerabilities
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: 6.0
Resumo:
It was discovered that nginx incorrectly handled certain configurations using the alias directive together with rewrite rules. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause nginx to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-15176) It was discovered that nginx incorrectly handled map directives using regex matching under certain circumstances. A remote attacker could poss...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8955-1
